BiblicalUsage: The word names a vestment or garment, and Isaiah uses it once, in the promise to those who mourn in Zion: God will give them the garment of praise for the spirit of heaviness, that they might be called trees of righteousness.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the garment of praise is God's own exchange: He takes the heaviness we wear and dresses us in praise instead.
